summary: Fixed REV-3 and QA-2 (both R1). docs/ui-tidy-up-plan.md now inventories the branch popover once: the duplicate D10 row is removed and the popover (role="dialog", a popover not a modal) is described in the single P9 panel row, with a §3 sentence explaining it is inventoried once with the panels. The Nine modal dialogs table is again exactly D1-D9. Added src/App.test.tsx 'R1: the plan lists each part in exactly one inventory entry', which parses the S/P/D/B and numbered top-bar inventory rows and asserts every component .tsx basename appears in exactly one row, so a duplicated part now fails the R1 test (it would have caught the old P9/D10 duplicate). Only docs/ui-tidy-up-plan.md and src/App.test.tsx changed. npm run lint clean; npx vitest run src/App.test.tsx 20 passing.

R1: the plan states each part's group, default visibility, how it is hidden again, remembered state, entry, laziness and package choice
R1: the plan lists each part in exactly one inventory entry
R3: Shell and Theme sit in the visible Appearance group, reachable without opening a dialog or the Utilities menu

R3: hides the advanced controls until Utilities is opened, and every hidden control has its way back
R3: an available update stays noticeable while Updates sits inside Utilities
R3: keeps every group in the header flow so a narrow window wraps instead of clipping them
R3: is hidden until it is opened and is hidden again with Escape
R3: clicking outside hides it again
R3: choosing an action runs it once and closes the menu
R3: the Updates item is disabled while a check runs and shows the waiting version otherwise
